audit.why: Early leans Ziggs on raw range (850 Q, 1000 Satchel), mid evens as Viktor's combo arrives, level 6 onward Viktor — matches packet chart and 50.17% WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike structure sound (range gap 1-2, close at 3-5, flip at 6/first item, dive him late).

Content mid calls Gravity Field (E) and 'Death Ray (W)' — real slots are W and E (Hextech Ray); spikes[3] and late lean on a nonexistent Viktor 'E-slow' (the slow is Gravity Field / the W augment); full chart rows 0,1,4,5 were 'Skill' against content/packet [Ziggs,Ziggs,Skill,Skill,Viktor,Viktor,Viktor]; cooldowns had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes. Short Fuse auto-reset tell (missingInteractions) was absent.
audit.why: Kit is the authority; content and packet charts agree.
audit.corrected: Names, slots and sides fixed with rewritten whys; cooldowns numbered (Satchel 20s->12s, R 120/95/70s); Short Fuse tell folded into dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: Satchel's 20s rank-1 downtime is the catch window.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions claims Satchel Charge bypasses stacking resistances; Riot's W text says nothing of the sort (the percentHealth flag looks like a parse of the turret-execute clause).
audit.why: Flag contradicts the description — trust the description.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches your farm from 850 range and Satchel zones the walk-up — level 1 you only take safe last hits.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: His range still pokes and zones your farm for free at 2 — the laser alone does not close an 850-range gap yet.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: At 6 your W-E-R all-in is real while his Mega Inferno Bomb is a sidestep — his only answer to the commit is Satchel-jump.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: First item and Q augment close the range gap: your single-target damage beats his poke, so shove him in and deny farm.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s at max — his only escape; he is catchable exactly while it is down. - His R is 120/95/70s and a dodgeable skillshot. - Your W is 17s at rank 1: it is the lifeline, and chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: His combo opens with a Short Fuse empowered auto — that wind-up is your cue: Q first, so the shield eats the bomb that follows it.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Ziggs matches your waveclear from 850-plus range and taxes towers while you walk — every failed chase pays him a plate.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Ziggs wins by poking with 850-range Bouncing Bombs, mining your walk-up, and Satchel-jumping the all-in you finally force.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 begin to even out as you get your combo online: hold Gravity Field (E) for when he steps to poke, and Death Ray (W) his position to trade back. Manage the wave so it isn't shoved into his tower where he pokes freely; a slow-push toward you lets you stack Q safely. This is the phase where you close the gap he opened.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 begin to even out as you get your combo online: hold Gravity Field (W) for when he steps to poke, and Hextech Ray (E) his position to trade back. Manage the wave so it isn't shoved into his tower where he pokes freely; a slow-push toward you lets you stack Q safely. This is the phase where you close the gap he opened.

edits.before: In teamfights Ziggs is pure AoE zone but has no mobility or self-peel beyond Satchel; dive him through your E-slow and Chaos Storm and he dies before he can retreat, and you win the extended fight.
edits.after: In teamfights Ziggs is pure AoE zone but has no mobility or self-peel beyond Satchel; dive him through Gravity Field and Chaos Storm and he dies before he can retreat, and you win the extended fight.

edits.before: From level 5 onward the matchup swings to you: your first item and Q augment match his range and your single-target damage beats his, so you shove him in, deny farm, and out-duel any poke exchange. His R is only a skillshot you can sidestep. In fights he has AoE zone but no mobility, so you dive through Satchel and E-slow him down and win every extended fight.
edits.after: From level 5 onward the matchup swings to you: your first item and Q augment match his range and your single-target damage beats his, so you shove him in, deny farm, and out-duel any poke exchange. His R is only a skillshot you can sidestep. In fights he has AoE zone but no mobility, so you dive past Satchel, Gravity Field him and win every extended fight.

notes: Full chart rows 0,1,4,5 moved to agree with content and packet (which already matched), whys rewritten; win[] correct so side edits stand alone. Slot fixes in content mid (Gravity Field is W, Hextech Ray is E — 'Death Ray (W)' was the packet-flagged name); the nonexistent Viktor 'E-slow' in spikes[3] and late re-attributed to Gravity Field. NOT written: the missingInteractions 'Satchel bypasses stacking resistances' claim — Riot's Satchel text describes a knockback and a turret execute, not resistance bypass; the percentHealth flag looks like a tooltip-parse misfire. Short Fuse auto-reset tell was added to dosFull[1].d.
